description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'SecondScreen' that acts as a splash/routing screen shown after the app's first run. It determines the next screen based on user preferences (language, login status) and navigates accordingly.

classes.name: SecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the splash/routing screen shown after the app's first run. It manages navigation to the appropriate next screen based on stored user preferences.

classes.name: _SecondScreenState
classes.description: State class for 'SecondScreen', handles initialization, determining the next screen, and building the UI for the splash screen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Overrides the StatefulWidget's initState to initialize the screen and trigger route decision after a delay.

methods.name: _routeAfterDelay
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for 1 second, checks user preferences to decide the next screen (language selection, home, or OTP validation), and navigates accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the splash screen, showing branding, progress indicator, and footer.
